description: This Java class 'ManufacturerController' is a Spring MVC Controller managing CRUD operations, listing, editing, creating, and deleting manufacturer entities within an admin panel of an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ManufacturerController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller for managing manufacturer entities in an admin web interface.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Handles GET request to list and display manufacturers.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new manufacturer.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Displays the form for editing an existing manufacturer based on provided ID.

methods.name: displayManufacturer
methods.description: Prepares and populates the model with manufacturer data for create/edit views.

methods.name: saveManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update manufacturer data, including validation.

methods.name: pageManufacturers
methods.description: Provides paginated XML/JSON data for manufacturer listing via AJAX.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to delete a manufacturer.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu context attributes for views.
